actors.name: Javier Milei
actors.role: President of Argentina, Leader of La Libertad Avanza
actors.blurb: Javier Milei continues to dominate the news cycle with his economic policies, re-election campaign, and controversial statements. His government is pushing key reforms in Congress, including the Central Bank reform and the 'Inocencia Fiscal II' bill, while facing internal tensions and public backlash over rising poverty and debt. Milei's efforts to bring Formula 1 back to Argentina and his confrontational rhetoric with critics and political allies alike keep him at the center of Argentine political discourse.

actors.name: Alice Weidel
actors.blurb: Alice Weidel remains a dominant figure in German politics as AfD leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt ahead of the September 6 election. Her recent media appearances, including a contentious ZDF interview, have focused on AfD's plans to exit the Euro and Schengen, stricter migration policies, and criticism of the current government. Weidel's uncompromising stance and AfD's potential to form Germany's first far-right state government keep her in the spotlight.

actors.name: Giorgia Meloni
actors.blurb: Giorgia Meloni remains a central figure in Italian politics, facing both domestic challenges and international scrutiny. Her recent visit to Amatrice for the 10th anniversary of the 2016 earthquake highlighted ongoing reconstruction efforts, while her appearance at the Mediterranean Games in Taranto was met with protests over fuel prices and economic policies. Meloni continues to navigate coalition dynamics, particularly with Lega, and address migration issues within the EU framework.
